import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET, shutil, uuid

ET.SubElement(rule, 'descr').text = 'antrieb: forward node1:80 -> node2:8080 for node3 only'
ET.SubElement(rule, 'associated-rule-id').text = 'pass'

tree.write(path, xml_declaration=True, encoding='utf-8')

ET.SubElement(rule, 'protocol').text = 'tcp'

ET.SubElement(rule, 'descr').text = 'antrieb: snat to lan ip for node2:8080 forward'

tree.write(path, xml_declaration=True, encoding='utf-8')
